title: Ledger and Typewriter
author: Xanthe Whitlock
blurb: Ada Yarrow, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
